address: Escritor Benito Pérez Galdós 33, Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, 35002, Spain
bio: A restaurant with plenty of personality and an appealing decor along an attractive pedestrian street in the city’s Triana district. Its cuisine is equally impressive, featuring market-inspired cooking with a modern touch and influences from the Canary Islands that is only available à la carte. We recommend booking ahead....
